result.rationale: The existing company is the correct ECP platform, but ADD_OWNER would duplicate ECP/Energy Capital Partners. ECP V remains majority owner; two later plant sales were asset realizations, not a PROENERGY sale.

identityResolution.boundary: PROENERGY is the PortCo. PROENERGY Services is an operating identity; WattBridge is its contracted-power subsidiary/segment; AeroAdvantage, PowerFLX and plants sit below the platform.

owners.stake: Invested alongside ECP; exact percentage NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED

ownershipResolution.priorSponsors: Eos Partners, L.P. and ACON Investments completed a financing in 2012 and were the selling sponsor affiliates in 2024. No continuing interest was disclosed.
ownershipResolution.aliasResolution: ECP equals Energy Capital Partners; retain one owner.
ownershipResolution.currentConclusion: ECP remains majority owner. The cap table, external co-investors and acquisition vehicle are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. Bridgepoint is ECP's parent, not a direct owner.

operatingResolution.business: Aeroderivative turbine/equipment manufacturing, turnkey EPC, contracted power and lifecycle care for utilities, municipalities, IPPs and data centers.
operatingResolution.footprint: Sedalia headquarters; global operations and Texas service presence, not a second headquarters.
operatingResolution.scale: At entry, 2.4 GW of Texas peakers and service exposure to more than 3,000 installed LM6000/LM2500 units.
operatingResolution.generationUpdate: CPS Energy bought four plants/1,632 MW on 2025-09-24 for $1.387bn; STEC bought two plants/768 MW on 2026-04-10 for $768m. Together they equal 2.4 GW. PROENERGY retained O&M/lifecycle contracts; no WattBridge entity sale was disclosed.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: Closed majority acquisition from Eos/ACON affiliates in August 2024; announced 2024-09-05. Exact day, percentage and vehicle are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
acquisitionExitCheck.assetRealizations: The six disclosed historic ERCOT plants were sold in two closed transactions; asset-level partial realizations, not a platform exit.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: Through 2026-08-19, no follow-on equity, recapitalization, company sale, owner transfer, portfolio removal or signed pending transaction was found. ECP marks PROENERGY Current; Bridgepoint's July 2026 report retains it in ECP V.

milestones.event: ECP closed a majority investment from Eos/ACON affiliates; announced 2024-09-05.
CPS Energy closed its $1.387bn purchase of four plants/1,632 MW.
STEC closed its $768m purchase of two plants/768 MW.
